senses.gloss: a. (-की f.) [[[P. IV. 3. 40]]; IV. 1. 15. उपकर्ण-ठक्] Being near the ears.

औपकार्यम्,
 
-र्या [उपकार्य-अण्] A residence, a tent; औपकार्यां स गत्वा तु रघूणां कुलवर्धनम् [[Rām. 1. 70. 12.]]
a. Pertaining to a ब्रह्मचारी of a stipulated period; [[Bhāg. 5. 9. 6.]]
Uddhava; [[Bhāg. 3. 4. 27.]]

औपग्रस्तिकः,
 
-ग्रहिकः [उपग्रस्त-ग्रह-ठञ्] 
__1 An eclipse. 
__2 The sun or moon in eclipse.

a. (-की f.) [उपचार-ठक्] 
__1 Meta phorical, figurative; secondary (opp. मुख्य). 
__2 Honorific, complimentary. 
-कम् Figurative application.
N. of a metre; see App.
a. (-की f.) [[[P. IV. 3. 40]]; IV. 1. 15. उपजानु-ठक्] Being near the knees.

a. (-की f.) [उपदेश-ठक्] 
__1 Living by उपदेश or teaching. 
__2 Got by instruction (as wealth).
a. (-की f.) [उपद्रव ठक्] Relating to, or treating of, symptoms (of diseases).

[उपद्रष्टृ-ष्यञ्] 
__1 Superintendence. 
__2 The state of being an eye-witness.

[उपधर्म-ष्यञ्] 
__1 A false doctrine, heresy वेशं विधाय बहुभाष्यत औपधर्म्यम् [[Bhāg. 2. 7. 37.]] 
__2 Inferior virtue, or a degraded principle of virtue.

a. (-की f.) Deceitful, deceptive. 
-कः An extortioner of money; [[Ms. 9. 258.]]

a. (-की f.) [उपाधि-ठञ्] 
__1 Conditional. 
__2 Pertaining to attributes or properties; an effect produced.

a. (-यी f.) [उपधि-ठञ्] Serving for the part of the wheel of a carriage called उपधि, q. v. 
-यम् The wheel of a carriage (रथाङ्गम्). यद्धि तद्रथाङ्गं तदौपधेयमित्युच्यते [[Mbh.]] [[V. 1. 13.]]
a. Belonging to, or serving for an offering.
a. (-की f.) [उपनयन-ठक्] Relating to or serving for उपनयन (the rite of investiture with the sacred thread); एष प्रोक्तो द्विजातीनामौपनायनिको विधिः [[Ms. 2. 68.]] [[Y. 1. 37.]]
(-की f.) [उपनास-ठञ्] Being near the nose.

a. 
(-की f.) [उपनिधि ठक्] Forming or relating to, a deposit; [[Kau. A. 3.]] 
-कम् A deposit or pledge; anything pledged or deposited; वासनस्थमनाख्याय हस्तेऽन्यस्य यदर्प्यते । द्रव्यं तदौपनिधिकं प्रतिदेयं तथैव तत् । [[Y. 2. 65]]; [[Śukra. 2. 316.]]
a. See औपनिधिक; [[Śukra. 2. 316.]]
a. (-की f.) [उपनिषदा जीवति ठक्] Living by (teaching) the Upaniṣads.

a. 
(-दी f.) [उपनिषद्-अण्] 
__1 Contained or taught in an Upaniṣad; scriptural, theological. तं त्वौपनिषदं पुरुषं पृच्छामि [[Bṛ. Up. 3. 9. 26.]] 
__2 Based or founded on, derived from, the Upaniṣads; धनुर्गृहीत्वौपनिषदं महास्त्रम् [[Muṇḍ. 2. 2. 3.]] औपनिषदं दर्शनम् (another name for Vedānta Phil.). 
-दः 
__1 The supreme soul, Brahman. 
__2 A follower of the doctrines of the Upaniṣads.

a. 
(-की f.) [[[P. IV. 3. 40]]; IV. 1. 15. उपनीवि-ठक्] Being or placed near नीबि (the knot of the wearing garment of males of females); बद्धो दुर्बलरक्षार्थमसिर्येनौपनीविकः [[Bk. 4. 26]]; औपनीविकमरुन्द्ध किल स्त्री (करम्) [[Śi. 10. 60.]]
[उपपक्ष-ष्यञ्] Being in the arm pit.

a. (-की f.) [उपपत्ति-ठक्] 
__1 Ready at hand within reach. 
__2 Fit, proper; औपपत्तिकमाहारं प्रयच्छस्बेति भारत [[Mb. 13. 52. 27.]] 
__3 Theoretical.

a. 
(-की f.) [उपपात-ठक्] One who has committed an Upapātaka, q. v. 
-कम् N. of the first Jaina Upāṅga.
Happiness occurring from a paramour; adultery; जुगुप्सितं च सर्वत्र औपपत्यं कुलास्त्रियाः [[Bhāg. 10. 29. 26.]]
An upstart (?) [[Kau. A. 1. 10.]]
a. (-ती f.) [उपभृत्-अल्] Being in the ladle (as an offering).

a. 
(-की f.) [उपमा-ठक्] 
__1 Serving for a simile or comparison. 
__2 Shown by a simile.
[उपमा-ष्यञ्] Comparison, resemblance, analogy; आत्मौपम्येन भूतेषु दयां कुर्वन्ति साधवः [[H. 1. 12]]; करका °सुभगः [[U. 3. 40.]] v. l.
a. (-जी f.) [उपयज्-अण्] Belonging to the sentences called उपयज्, q. v.

औपयिक,
 
-औपायिक a. 
(-की f.) [उपाय-ठक्] 
__1 Proper, fit, right; नैतदौपयिकं राम यदिदं परितप्यसे [[Rām. 2. 53. 30]]; [[Bhāg. 3. 2. 12.]] न वैश्यशूद्रौपयिकीः कथाः [[Mb. 1. 193. 11.]] 
__2 Obtained by efforts. 
-कः -कम् A means, an expedient, remedy; शिवमौपयिकं गरीयसीम् [[Ki. 2. 35.]]
= औपयिक q. v.
a. (-की f.) [उपयोग-ठञ्] Relating to the employment or application (of anything).
a. [उपराज-ठक्] Relating or belonging to a viceroy.

a. (-ष्टी f.) [उपरिष्ट-अण्] Being or produced above. 
-कम् A kind of coitus; [[Vātsy.]]
A staff made of the wood of the Pilu tree.

औपरो(रौ)धिक
 
(-की f.) [उपरोध-ठक्] 
__1 Proceeding from or relating to favour or kindness. 
__2 Opposing, impending. 
-कः A staff of the wood of the Pilu tree.

a. (-ला, -ली f.) [उपल-अण्] 
__1 Stony, of stone; यथा प्लवेनौपलेन निमज्जत्युदके तरन् [[Ms. 4. 194.]] v. l. 
__2 Raised from stones (as a tax). पाहि औपलामम्बिकाम् [[Nṛ. P. Up. 3. 1.]]
Fasting, a fast.

[उपवस्त्र-अण्] 
__1 Food suitable for a fast. 
__2 Fasting. उपवस्ता प्राप्तोस्यौपवस्त्रम् [[Mbh.]] [[V. 1. 97.]]
a. (-सी f.) [उपवास-अण्] Given during fasting (money); to be done during fast.
a. (-की f.) [उपवास-ठञ्] Fit for fasting, able to fast.
Fasting. औपवास्यं तदाकार्षीद्राघवः सह सीतया [[Rām. 2. 87. 18.]]

a. [उपवाह्य स्वार्थे अण्] 
__1 Serving for riding on; औपवाह्यं रथं युक्त्वा त्वमायाहि हयोत्तमैः [[Rām. 2. 39. 10.]] 
__2 Drawn for pleasure (as a carriage). 
-ह्यः 
__1 A king's elephant. 
__2 Any royal vehicle. औपवाह्यः कुबेरस्य सार्वभौम इति स्मृतः [[Rām. 4. 43. 34.]]
Investiture with the sacred thread.
a. (-की f.) [उपवेष-ठञ्] Getting livelihood by entire devotion to any employment.
N. of a grammarian.
a. (-की f.) [उपश्लेष-ठक्] Relating to close or immediate contact; अधिकरणं नाम त्रिप्रकारं व्यापकमौपश्लेषिकं वैषयिकमिति [[Mbh.]] VI. 1. 12.

a. 
(-णी f.) (Anything) proper to be done at the Upasaṅkramaṇa.

a. (-की f.) [उपसंख्यान-ठक्] 
__1 Mentioned in a supplementary addition. 
__2 Supplementary.

[उपसद्-अण्] 
__1 An अध्याय or अनुवाक containing the word उपसद्. 
__2 N. of a ceremony lasting for one day.
a. Relating to dawn; [[N.]]

a. (-की f.) [उपसर्ग-ठञ्] 
__1 Able to cope with adversity. 
__2 Portentous. 
__3 Relating to change &c. 
__4 Super-induced (as a disease). 
__5 Connected with a preposition, prepositive. 
-कः Irregular action of the humours of the body, producing cold sweats &c. (वातादिसंनिपात).
(-नी f.) [उपस्थान-ण] One whose business is to serve, wait on, or worship.
a. (-की f.) [उपस्थान-ठक्] Living by waiting on or worshipping.
[उपस्थ-ष्यञ्] Cohabitation, sexual intercourse; औपस्थ्यजैह्वयं बहु मन्यमानः कथं विरज्येत दुरन्तमोहः [[Bhāg. 7. 6. 13.]]
a. [उपस्थ-ठक्] Living by fornication.
An attendant; एष भर्तृपादमूलादौपस्थितिको हंसकः आगतः [[Pratijñā. 1.]]

a. (-की f.) [उपहार-ठक्] Serving as an oblation or offering. 
-कम् An offering or oblation; परमान्नेन यो दद्यात् पितॄणामौपहारिकम् [[Mb. 13. 126. 35.]]
a. (-की f.) [उपाध्याय-बुञ् [[P. IV. 3. 77]] ] Coming or obtained from a teacher.

a. [उपानह्-ञ्य] 
__1 Used for making shoes. 
__2 To be tied or bound on (as leather &c.).

a. (-नी f.) [उपासन-अण्] 
__1 Relating to गृह्याग्नि or household fire. 
__2 Belonging to worship or service; holy, sacred. 
-नः 
__1 A fire used for domestic worship. 
__2 A small rice-ball (पिण्ड) offered to the manes.
